entries.en: to look with clear, awakened eyes; distinct to the eye
entries.notes: M栏两音节均T99污損且R栏空缺，据汉栏「醒眼」与西语词头 miras（mirar 变位）定释义

entries.zh: 目猜猜；定睛瞪视（紧盯不放）
entries.en: to stare fixedly, with an intent gaze
entries.notes: M音两处T99污損；「猜猜」为叠字状语，按西语 mirar de hito en hito（凝视）释义

entries.zh: 瞷目入神；凝神谛视（注目出神）
entries.en: to gaze fixedly in contemplation; to stare entranced
entries.notes: M音多处T99污損；据汉栏「目瞷相入神」与西语 en contemplación 释义

entries.zh: 看不真切；视而未确（首字疑「着/看」）
entries.en: to look without being sure of what one sees; to fail to see clearly
entries.notes: 汉栏首字疑「着/看」且M音两音节T99污損，按西语 no certificarse（看而不确）释义

entries.en: to look sideways, askance; squint
entries.notes: 仅M音两音节T99污損，L/H 两栏互证清晰（斜視＝mirar de medio lado）

entries.zh: 无意间看着人；视线无心落于人
entries.en: to let one's gaze fall on someone without intent; a careless sideways look
entries.notes: M第三音节与汉栏「着」对应存疑且含T99污損，按汉栏「無意着人」直读释义

entries.en: to cast a sidelong glance; to peer askance
entries.notes: M音两音节T99污損，「chian quy」与「瞄起」对应靠推断，语义据同组西栏（侧视）语境

entries.en: to gaze expectantly into the distance; to look forward to
entries.notes: M音两音节T99污損；L/H/M 语义一致（mirar esperando＝瞻望）

entries.en: 〔source damaged, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 西语栏[残]且M音三音节全T99污損，仅存汉栏「相上天」，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 探看水深几许（存字疑「首/水」）
entries.en: to gauge how deep the water is (surviving character uncertain: 首/水)
entries.notes: 西栏残讹（grime jisonso）且汉栏字疑「首/水」、M音全T99，释义仅据推断

entries.zh: 使目箭射人；以目射人（含情或含怒的目光）
entries.en: to shoot arrows from the eyes at someone; a killing or amorous glance
entries.notes: 西栏[残]（「con los chi quiere matar」当为 con los ojos que quiere matar）并M音T99污損，按汉栏「目箭射人」释义

entries.zh: 约正（乡约之首，主公议公益者）；顾念公益
entries.en: head of the village covenant (xiangyue) charged with the common good; to look after the common welfare
entries.notes: 「約正」与西语 bien común 的对应依赖明代乡约制史实推断，且R栏本页空缺

entries.zh: 没药（没藥，药用香脂）；存字疑「藥/黄」
entries.en: myrrh (aromatic gum resin used as medicine and incense)
entries.notes: 汉栏字疑「藥/黄」且M栏「vi ni」后残缺；按17世纪西语 Mirra＝没药定释义

entries.zh: 儉省；拘谨节制（字疑「儉/慊」）
entries.en: frugal, sparing; restrained, guarded in manner (to look with modest care)
entries.notes: 汉栏字疑（儉/慊）且M栏残缺；西栏「mirar recatado」（拘谨地看）与汉栏「儉省」语义关联待复核

entries.en: mercy, compassion; merciful
entries.notes: L/H/M 三栏互证清晰（misericordia＝憐），但R栏本页空缺，不足四栏互证

entries.en: benevolence; mercy and forbearance
entries.notes: M音两音节（xin chu，疑为「仁恕」）而汉栏仅存「仁」，且R栏本页空缺

entries.en: to pity, have compassion
entries.notes: 汉栏字疑「怜/憐」（同词异体），M音「leng」与常读稍异，降为 medium

entries.en: pitiable, worthy of pity
entries.notes: M第二音节T99污損；L/H/M 语义一致（misericordia＝可怜）

entries.zh: 恻隐（惻隱之心）；慈悲怜悯
entries.en: compassion, pity; merciful
entries.notes: M音两音节（cheg un，疑为「惻隱」）而汉栏仅存「惻」，且含T99污損

entries.en: kind, merciful, compassionate
entries.notes: L/H/M 三栏互证清晰（misericordioso＝慈），但R栏本页空缺，不足四栏互证

entries.en: compassionate sorrow, pity
entries.notes: M第二音节T99污損；L/H/M 语义一致（misericordioso＝惻怛）
